CustomField.description: This is an internal field used to track the moment a new form spins up, which is when the respondent's session begins. CreatedDate only reflects the record insert, and deferred-save and autosave-off configurations can delay that insert well past the true start, so use this field as the anchor for time-to-complete and abandonment reporting. It is stamped once and never overwritten on resume, Save Progress, autosave or submit. Prefill templates are never stamped, and the value is never carried into a submission seeded from a prefill template.
CustomField.label: Form Start Date Time
